scope: Four cached models in two different comparable groups; no model rerun.

protocol.joint_definition: Wrist plus MCP/PIP/DIP of thumb,index,middle,ring,little; excludes all five fingertip slots to avoid incompatible native tip markers.
protocol.coordinate_frame: Original RGB camera axes (OpenCV xyz), meters; errors in mm. Model-specific intrinsic estimation/calibration is retained.
protocol.hand_mapping: Fixed left/right anatomical slots. EgoHSI3R source right,left is permuted once to left,right. No GT-error matching.
protocol.strict_validity: GT valid AND finite Base16 AND model valid AND no explicit missing-hand fill. EgoHSI3R uses original detector hand_mask, without generating missing hands.
protocol.common_mask: Intersection of strict method masks for each explicitly named group; all its scored methods use the same hand/frame set.
protocol.coverage: Method strict available hand-frames / every annotated hand-frame in its group. An absent experiment is null, not a failure.
protocol.pck50: Correct camera-space Base16 joints <=50 mm / all annotated Base16 joints; missing/filled predictions count as failures. This is NOT the common-error subset.
protocol.pa: One proper-rotation positive-scale similarity fit per hand/frame on exactly the same 16 points. No alignment for raw error/PCK.
protocol.acceleration: Wrist-relative Base16 acceleration error with shared actual GT timestamps; only three consecutive source frames valid for all methods, never across clip boundaries.
protocol.hggt_absolute: HGGT native camera output is primary. Existing calibration-only translation adapter is reported separately; no GT fit. Root-relative/PA use native output.
protocol.aggregation: Hand-frame weighted errors, triplet-weighted acceleration, joint-weighted PCK, summed coverage counts. Not a mean of clip means.
limitations: Four fixed development clips, not an official benchmark or a guaranteed training-disjoint test.
Only DexYCB camera A 836212060125 and Aria RGB 214-1 are matched.
Same source recording/camera/frame IDs and GT; different video encodings, model detectors, crops, calibration and temporal processing are retained.
EgoHSI3R default RGB predicts its own K; no GT calibration, GT boxes, later trained ablation, focal or reset variant is substituted.
Base16 excludes all five fingertip definitions. Original 21-point tables and the previous three-method report remain unchanged.
Lower scores across different groups cannot be ranked against one another.
protocol.group_policy: DexYCB compares HaWoR/HGGT/EgoHSI3R on 146 right-hand frames. Aria compares HaWoR/EgoFound3R/HGGT on 565 hand-frames. No pooled cross-group ranking.
protocol.four_way_comparison: No all-four common valid hand-frame exists. EgoFound3R failed on the matched Dex camera A, and EgoHSI3R was not run on these Aria samples.
